formula_checks.name: theDebts
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Known positive balances produce the debt total, but missing balances/rates/payments lack complete-total flags and the payoff horizon can be misreported as never.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Expose partial coverage and pass through distinct incomplete/nonamortizing/horizon states.
formula_checks.records_or_app_fix: app fix (theDebts / payoffPlan) and records (MK-CF-M-058's refusal words)
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: One debt whose payment was never entered (the debt editor saves a blank payment as not entered since 2026-10-21) turns the whole plan into "never": the minimums become NaN, the walk stops in month 1 and neverPaysOff is set. The /month min total silently adds nothing for it, and paymentsMonthly (what leaves each month) comes back NaN. A missing BALANCE has no reachable writer (OUTSIDE DOMAIN, case C05).
formula_checks.plain_example: Visa $3,200 at 22.90% with $110 entered and a car loan $9,800 at 6.40% with its payment not entered: Debts reads "debt-free never at this rate" and "$110/month in payments". Right: no payoff date, and the car loan named as having no payment entered.

formula_checks.name: actualDebtPayment
formula_checks.reviewer_why: The legacy name says actual but the formula is a planned obligation, not logged payments. The owner chose a payment override as the normal monthly plan, but actual-month records must not reuse it.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Label this as planned monthly payments, and reserve actually paid for dated logs.
formula_checks.records_or_app_fix: records fix: the rule text — the card and the code header call it "Σ ACTUAL payments … what actually leaves your account"; it is the planned monthly payment (the chosen payment, else the minimum)
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Returns totalDebtMonthly, the chosen payment (DEC-0641).
